strings.zh: 有个黑皮肤的训练家{NEWLINE}说我完全不会培育小福蛋,{CLEAR}让一只潜力巨大的精灵{CLEAR}只维持在宝宝形态是一种浪费。{CLEAR}我确实养了小福蛋好久了,{CLEAR}可是它一直都没有进化,{CLEAR}是不是真像那个训练家说的那样,{CLEAR}我没有培养精灵的天赋,{CLEAR}让小福蛋留在我身边是在耽误它啊。
strings.en: A dark-skinned Trainer told me I have{NEWLINE}no idea how to raise Happiny. They said{CLEAR}keeping a Pokémon with so much{CLEAR}potential in its baby form is a waste.{SCROLL}It’s true I’ve been raising my Happiny{NEWLINE}for ages, but it still hasn’t evolved.{SCROLL}Is that Trainer right? Do I have no{NEWLINE}talent for raising Pokémon? Am I holding{CLEAR}Happiny back by keeping it with me?
strings.notes: 黑皮肤的训练家: unnamed; possibly an anime/Unova reference (Iris?). Kept literal. | RV044: addition: zh gives no gender for the Trainer

strings.zh: 进化变强并不是唯一目的
strings.en: Evolving isn’t everything
strings.notes: choice: #1 → #4/#5 (encourage), #2 → #6–#14 (ask for Happiny; it refuses), #3 decline.; ext-review C013

strings.zh: 那你把小福蛋给我吧
strings.en: Then give Happiny to me

strings.zh: 不关我事
strings.en: Not my problem

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『培育精灵的意义{NEWLINE}不该局限于变强,{CLEAR}你与精灵经历的点点滴滴、{CLEAR}共同创造的美好回忆,{CLEAR}这都是我们和精灵在一起的意义。{CLEAR}所以不管别人怎么说,{CLEAR}只要你和小福蛋在一起{CLEAR}感到开心快乐就好了。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Raising Pokémon isn’t{NEWLINE}only about getting stronger.{SCROLL}All the little moments you{NEWLINE}share, the happy memories you{CLEAR}make together... That’s what{CLEAR}being with Pokémon is all about.{SCROLL}So whatever anyone else says, as{NEWLINE}long as you and Happiny are happy{CLEAR}together, that’s what matters.

strings.zh: 你说的好有道理！{NEWLINE}我不自觉地被那个训练家的语言引导,{CLEAR}居然错误地以为{CLEAR}不能变强对精灵来说就不幸福。{SCROLL}多亏有你点醒我,{NEWLINE}让我更清晰地认识到了{CLEAR}与精灵在一起的丰富意义,{CLEAR}不然我可能要纠结好久了。{CLEAR}这个小礼物送给你就当是谢礼吧。
strings.en: You’re so right! I let that{NEWLINE}Trainer’s words lead me astray. I{CLEAR}actually believed that not getting{CLEAR}stronger made a Pokémon unhappy.{SCROLL}Thanks to you, I see more clearly{NEWLINE}how much being with Pokémon really{CLEAR}means. I might have agonized{CLEAR}over this for ages otherwise.{SCROLL}Please take this little gift as thanks.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『你把小福蛋交给我培育吧,{NEWLINE}我保证让它变成强大的精灵。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Let me raise Happiny. I{NEWLINE}promise I’ll make it a strong Pokémon.

strings.zh: 你好像有很多徽章啊,{NEWLINE}应该是个很厉害的训练家吧。{CLEAR}嗯……
strings.en: You seem to have lots of Badges.{NEWLINE}You must be a really strong Trainer.{SCROLL}Hmm...

strings.zh: 小福蛋,继续跟着我{NEWLINE}你可能永远都没法变强了,{CLEAR}现在我把你交给这位训练家培育,{CLEAR}你愿意吗？
strings.en: Happiny, if you keep following me,{NEWLINE}you might never get stronger.{CLEAR}Would you like me to hand you{CLEAR}over to this Trainer to raise?

strings.zh: 小福蛋『Haa——pi！{SCROLL}小福蛋摇了摇头。
strings.en: Happiny: Haa-pi!{SCROLL}Happiny shook its head.

strings.zh: 你……不愿意变强,{NEWLINE}想留在我身边吗？
strings.en: You... don’t want to get stronger?{NEWLINE}You want to stay with me?

strings.zh: 小福蛋『Haa——pi！{SCROLL}小福蛋点了点头。
strings.en: Happiny: Haa-pi!{SCROLL}Happiny nodded.

strings.zh: 但我不是一个称职的训练家,{NEWLINE}培育了你这么久,{CLEAR}都没能让你进化、变强,{CLEAR}你跟着厉害一点的训练家{CLEAR}可能进步地会更快啊。
strings.en: But I’m not a proper Trainer.{NEWLINE}I’ve raised you for so long,{CLEAR}and I still couldn’t make{CLEAR}you evolve or get stronger.{SCROLL}With a better Trainer, you{NEWLINE}might improve a lot faster.

strings.zh: 我明白了,你是不想离开我。{NEWLINE}呜呜呜……确实……{CLEAR}从把你孵化出来开始,{CLEAR}咱们一起吃饭、一起旅行、一起泡温泉,{CLEAR}留下了很多美好回忆,{CLEAR}虽然这些回忆不能让你变强,{CLEAR}但是却让咱们的感情羁绊更加深刻,{CLEAR}或许培育精灵的意义{CLEAR}并不仅仅是变强,{CLEAR}在一起时的幸福感才是最重要的。
strings.en: I get it. You don’t want to leave{NEWLINE}me. Waaah... You’re right...{SCROLL}Ever since you hatched, we’ve{NEWLINE}eaten together, traveled together,{CLEAR}soaked in hot springs together...{CLEAR}We made so many happy memories.{SCROLL}Those memories didn’t make{NEWLINE}you stronger, but they{CLEAR}made our bond deeper.{SCROLL}Maybe raising Pokémon isn’t just about{NEWLINE}getting stronger. Maybe the happiness{CLEAR}of being together is what matters most.

strings.zh: 对不起啊,{NEWLINE}我现在觉得变强没那么重要了,{CLEAR}跟小福蛋在一起才是最重要的,{CLEAR}所以小福蛋不能给你了。{CLEAR}不过为了表达歉意,{CLEAR}这个送给你就当做是补偿吧。
strings.en: I’m sorry. I don’t think getting{NEWLINE}stronger matters so much now. Being{CLEAR}with Happiny is what matters most,{CLEAR}so I can’t give Happiny to you.{SCROLL}But to say sorry, please{NEWLINE}take this to make up for it.

strings.zh: 对于我这样的训练家来说,{NEWLINE}变强与否可能真的不重要,{CLEAR}与自己喜欢的精灵一起享受生活{CLEAR}这才是最重要的。
strings.en: For a Trainer like me, getting{NEWLINE}stronger may not really matter.{CLEAR}Enjoying life with the Pokémon{CLEAR}I love is what matters most.

strings.zh: 小福蛋『Haa——pi！
strings.en: Happiny: Haa-pi!

strings.zh: 我的朋友把天蝎寄养在了我这里,{NEWLINE}可是朋友的天蝎{CLEAR}非常喜欢我的斗笠菇的剧毒珠,{CLEAR}两只精灵经常为了抢剧毒珠而打架。{CLEAR}要是再有一个剧毒珠就好了……
strings.en: A friend of mine left their Gligar with{NEWLINE}me. But my friend’s Gligar just loves my{CLEAR}Breloom’s Toxic Orb, and the two of{CLEAR}them keep fighting over it.{SCROLL}If only I had one more Toxic Orb...
strings.notes: RV044: addition: zh gives no gender for the friend

strings.zh: 要把身上的剧毒珠送给她吗？
strings.en: Give her the Toxic Orb you have?

strings.zh: 你有剧毒珠要送给我？{NEWLINE}真是太感谢了,{CLEAR}这样一来两个孩子{CLEAR}就不会因为抢玩具而打闹了。
strings.en: You’ll give me a Toxic{NEWLINE}Orb? Thank you so much!{SCROLL}Now those two won’t squabble{NEWLINE}over their toy anymore.

strings.zh: 斗笠菇、天蝎,你们别闹了！{NEWLINE}快看我手里的这个,{CLEAR}这是你们最喜欢的剧毒珠哦！
strings.en: Breloom, Gligar, stop it, you{NEWLINE}two! Look what I’ve got here.{CLEAR}It’s your favorite Toxic Orb!

strings.zh: 斗笠菇『Breee——loo！
strings.en: Breloom: Breee-loo!

strings.zh: 天蝎『Gliii……
strings.en: Gligar: Gliii...

strings.zh: 现在有了两个剧毒珠,{NEWLINE}你们一人一个就不要再抢了。
strings.en: Now there are two Toxic Orbs.{NEWLINE}One each, so no more fighting.

strings.zh: 天蝎『Gliii——ga！{SCROLL}天蝎对剧毒珠似乎没什么兴趣了。
strings.en: Gligar: Gliii-ga!{SCROLL}Gligar doesn’t seem very interested{NEWLINE}in the Toxic Orb anymore.

strings.zh: 来,天蝎,拿着吧,{NEWLINE}以后这个就是你的剧毒珠了。
strings.en: Here, Gligar, take it. From now{NEWLINE}on, this Toxic Orb is yours.

strings.zh: 天蝎……？{NEWLINE}你不是很喜欢剧毒珠吗？
strings.en: Gligar...? Don’t you love Toxic Orbs?

strings.zh: 天蝎『Gliii——ga！
strings.en: Gligar: Gliii-ga!
Wha...

strings.zh: 对不起啊,{NEWLINE}有了两个剧毒珠之后,{CLEAR}天蝎好像就对剧毒珠没那么喜欢了。{CLEAR}所以剧毒珠还是还给你吧。
strings.en: I’m sorry. Now that there are two{NEWLINE}Toxic Orbs, Gligar doesn’t seem{CLEAR}to like them so much anymore.{SCROLL}So I’d better give your Toxic Orb back.

strings.zh: 拿回了剧毒珠。
strings.en: Got the Toxic Orb back.

strings.zh: 耽误了你这么多时间真是不好意思,{NEWLINE}这个作为补偿送给你吧。
strings.en: I’m sorry for taking up so much of your{NEWLINE}time. Please take this to make up for it.

strings.zh: 自从把剧毒珠还给你之后,{NEWLINE}天蝎似乎又对{CLEAR}斗笠菇的剧毒珠感兴趣了。{CLEAR}这种性格就跟个小孩子一样。
strings.en: Ever since I gave your Toxic Orb{NEWLINE}back, Gligar’s been interested{CLEAR}in Breloom’s Toxic Orb again.{CLEAR}It’s just like a little kid.

strings.zh: 好啦,你们两个别闹了！
strings.en: All right, you two, knock it off!

strings.zh: 哦？是观光客吗？{NEWLINE}看到外面的相机了吗？{CLEAR}用它拍张照片吧！{SCROLL}拍好的照片可以在{NEWLINE}精灵中心的电脑上查看,{CLEAR}一边旅行一边拍照,{CLEAR}与精灵留下美好的回忆吧。
strings.en: Oh? Are you a tourist? Did you see the{NEWLINE}camera outside? Use it to take a photo!{SCROLL}You can view your photos on{NEWLINE}the PC at a Pokémon Center. Take{CLEAR}pictures as you travel and make{CLEAR}happy memories with your Pokémon.

strings.zh: 各地的道馆馆主们{NEWLINE}有时会离开道馆闲逛,{CLEAR}如果你能在道馆之外的地方{CLEAR}遇见这些馆主,{CLEAR}我想他们应该会很高兴与你来张合影。{SCROLL}但是他们每个人外出的时间都不一样,{NEWLINE}如果你想知道的话我可以告诉你。{SCROLL}想打听哪位馆主的外出时间？
strings.en: Gym Leaders from all over sometimes{NEWLINE}leave their Gyms to wander around.{SCROLL}If you run into them away from{NEWLINE}their Gyms, I bet they’d be{CLEAR}happy to take a photo with you.{SCROLL}But they each go out at{NEWLINE}different times. If you want{CLEAR}to know, I can tell you.{SCROLL}Which Gym Leader’s outing{NEWLINE}times would you like to know?

strings.en: Back in the day, it took me{NEWLINE}a lot of work to find out how{CLEAR}to evolve Eevee into Glaceon.{SCROLL}If you can beat my Glaceon,{NEWLINE}I’ll tell you how it’s done.{SCROLL}So, want to have a match with me?

strings.zh: 看到这么稀有的冰精灵,{NEWLINE}你是害怕了吗？
strings.en: What, are you scared{NEWLINE}of such a rare Glaceon?

strings.zh: 嘿嘿,让你看看冰精灵的厉害！
strings.en: Heh heh, I’ll show you{NEWLINE}what Glaceon can do!

strings.zh: 你好强啊！{NEWLINE}像你这么强的训练家{CLEAR}有资格成为冰精灵的主人,{CLEAR}所以请收下这个吧！
strings.en: You’re so strong! A Trainer as{NEWLINE}strong as you deserves to own{CLEAR}a Glaceon. So please take this!

strings.zh: 如果你也有伊布的话,{NEWLINE}试着让它带上这个不融冰升级,{CLEAR}这样就能进化成冰精灵了。
strings.en: If you have an Eevee too, try leveling{NEWLINE}it up while it holds this Never-Melt{CLEAR}Ice. Then it’ll evolve into Glaceon.

strings.zh: 据说在神奥地区,{NEWLINE}伊布有别的方式能进化成冰精灵。{CLEAR}但在城都地区,{CLEAR}要得到冰精灵就只能依靠不融冰了。
strings.en: They say Eevee has another{NEWLINE}way to evolve into Glaceon{CLEAR}in the Sinnoh region.{SCROLL}But in the Johto region, Never-Melt{NEWLINE}Ice is the only way to get a Glaceon.

strings.zh: 如你所见,我们三兄弟都是{NEWLINE}使用伊布的训练家。{CLEAR}如果你能答对我提出的{CLEAR}关于伊布的问题,{CLEAR}我就送你一个珍贵的道具。{CLEAR}要不要试试啊？
strings.en: As you can see, we three{NEWLINE}brothers all use Eevee.{SCROLL}If you can answer my questions about{NEWLINE}Eevee correctly, I’ll give you a{CLEAR}precious item. Want to give it a try?

strings.zh: 什么时候想试试了再来找我。
strings.en: Come find me whenever{NEWLINE}you want to give it a try.

strings.zh: 不错不错,{NEWLINE}居然能回答对我的全部问题,{CLEAR}看来你平时也很喜欢伊布啊。{CLEAR}那么这颗进化奇石送给你,{CLEAR}你让还能继续进化的精灵带上它试试,{CLEAR}或许会有意想不到的效果哦。
strings.en: Not bad at all! You got every{NEWLINE}one of my questions right. You{CLEAR}must really love Eevee too.{SCROLL}So here, take this Eviolite. Have{NEWLINE}a Pokémon that can still evolve hold{CLEAR}it. It might have a surprising effect.

strings.zh: 仙子精灵是最新发现的伊布形态,{NEWLINE}几乎没有训练家拥有这只精灵,{CLEAR}你如果带一只仙子精灵上街的话,{CLEAR}一定非常吸睛。
strings.en: Sylveon is the most recently{NEWLINE}discovered form of Eevee.{CLEAR}Hardly any Trainers own one.{SCROLL}If you took a Sylveon out on the{NEWLINE}street, you’d turn every head.
